items.title: SBI Funds makes strong D-St debut, ends 6.3% above IPO price
items.description: SBI Funds Management debuted on the stock market at a premium price.  The company raised over ₹9,813 crore through its initial public offering.  SBI plans no further stake dilution in the asset management company.  The fund house is investing in new Alternative Investment Funds capabilities.  SBI Funds aims to expand its reach into B30 markets.

items.title: Stock Radar: Himadri Speciality stock hits fresh record high in July 2026; time to buy?
items.description: In July 2026, Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd's stock soared to new heights, stirring excitement among investors. Experts urge buying the stock with a target set at 800. The stock has surged over 60% in the previous quarter and is currently positioned above pivotal moving averages.

items.title: Karur Vysya Bank among 5 stocks that closed above VWAP, signaling bullish shift
items.description: VWAP: Rs 1464.29 | LTP: Rs 1488.5

items.title: TVS Motor Company among 5 stocks flashing bullish signals, indicating possible uptrend
items.description: On July 21, five stocks in the Nifty500 appeared on the ‘White Marubozu’ bullish scanner, according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period and the closing price is the highest.Represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and a small or nonexistent lower shadow, it indicates strong buying pressure throughout the session. Traders interpret it as a signal that buyers were in control from the opening to the closing, often using such patterns for informed decisions about future price movements in financial markets.

items.title: Sun Pharma, Cipla, other pharma stocks in focus as Trump unveils 100%, 200% tariffs on generic drugs from 2028
items.description: Indian pharma stocks are likely to remain in focus after US President Donald Trump announced a phased tariff plan for generic medicines, offering a two-year tariff exemption before imposing steep duties from 2028.

items.title: Jaiprakash Power Ventures among 4 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On July 21, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 3% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from lower levels. “RSI trending up” indicates that Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are rising, suggesting strengthening momentum in the stock’s price action. This can indicate potential upward movement and is often used by traders to identify buying opportunities in momentum-driven markets.

items.title: Modi’s protectionism push creates stock winners in laggard India
items.description: A Bloomberg-compiled basket of 15 stocks linked to import substitution has rallied more than 20% since the start of the Middle East conflict, outperforming the benchmark NSE Nifty 50 Index, which has dropped about 2%. The rally stands out as the basket has become a haven for investors seeking shelter from broader market volatility.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 8 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, eight stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200 DMA (Daily Moving Averages) on July 21, 2026, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data. The 200-day daily moving average (DMA) is a key indicator traders use to determine the overall trend in a particular stock. As long as the stock is priced above the 200-day SMA on the daily timeframe, it is generally considered to be in an overall uptrend. Take a look:

items.title: Sebi directs depositories to freeze promoter holdings during buyback period
items.description: Sebi has directed depositories to freeze promoter holdings during company buyback periods.  This restriction will be in effect from board approval until the offer closes.  Promoters can still participate in buybacks through the tender offer route.  Existing pledges created before the buyback period can also be invoked.  Depositories must implement these operational systems by August 1.

items.title: Stocks in news: IndusInd Bank, Adani Green, Eternal, Maruti Suzuki, Bandhan Bank
items.description: Indian markets closed marginally higher after balancing mixed global cues and positive earnings. Adani Energy Solutions reported significant profit growth, while Adani Total Gas saw a decline. Maruti Suzuki announced a price increase, and several companies will report quarterly results soon. Bandhan Bank and Indian Hotels also posted strong first-quarter financial performances. Investors are watching key heavyweight sectors and upcoming company announcements closely.

items.title: D-St set for a negative opening as GIFT Nifty signals weak start
items.description: Domestic equities extended losses for a second consecutive session on Tuesday.  Higher crude oil prices and geopolitical tensions pressured the market significantly.  Analysts expect equities to remain range-bound amid ongoing global uncertainties.  The ongoing Q1 earnings season will drive stock-specific actions and investor sentiment.  The Indian rupee firmed slightly as diplomacy hopes eased oil price concerns.

In such times, expecting rational behaviour in the equity (or commodity) market is probably expecting too much. At this juncture, investors need to develop the ability to either keep out of the market or invest only with a long-term perspective. items.title: SBI Funds' ESOPs mint fortunes for top executives
items.description: SBI Funds Management executives received significant value from employee stock options after the company's listing. Joint CEO Devinder Pal Singh holds shares and outstanding options worth over ₹160 crore. Chief Investment Officer Srinivasan Rama Iyer's stake and ESOPs together exceed ₹165 crore. Other senior officials also saw substantial gains from their allotted employee stock options.

items.title: RBI plans unified code for foreign investment in equity instruments
items.description: The Reserve Bank of India proposed new rules for overseas fund flows. These draft norms will replace existing regulations governing foreign investment. The framework clarifies eligible entities and defines foreign-controlled entities clearly. It also retains the distinction between direct and portfolio foreign investments. The proposed rules aim to streamline foreign investment into Indian markets.

items.title: FPIs stay in buying mode, consumer services lead sectoral inflows in first half of July
items.description: Overseas investors became net buyers in the first half of July, marking a strong inflow period. Consumer services, metals, and healthcare sectors attracted the most foreign investment. IT sector saw marginal buying after months of consistent selling by foreign investors. Banks also received significant inflows, continuing their positive trend from June.

items.title: KKR-backed Serentica Renewables lands massive $1.19B despite project delays and debt refinancing
items.description: Serentica Renewables has secured over $1.19 billion across three financing transactions. This funding will accelerate capacity expansion and support delayed renewable energy projects. A $345 million loan comes from the Asian Development Bank and other lenders. MUFG underwrote a $397 million green term loan now being syndicated. The company aims to supply over 50 billion units of clean energy annually.

items.title: AI-focused E2E Networks shares hit 5% upper circuit as firm swings to black in Q1, revenue soars 334%
items.description: AI-focused cloud provider E2E Networks hit the upper circuit after reporting a sharp turnaround in Q1FY27, posting a net profit of Rs 44 crore against a year-ago loss. Revenue more than quadrupled, while EBITDA and margins surged, driven by strong demand for AI infrastructure and expanded GPU deployment.

items.title: MedPlus Health shares tumble 16% after Q1 profit falls 21% YoY. Should you buy, sell or hold?
items.description: MedPlus Health Services shares tumbled after the company reported a weaker-than-expected Q1FY27. Despite healthy 21.9% revenue growth to ₹1,880 crore, investors were disappointed by the profitability miss. Brokerage Nomura maintained its 'Buy' rating, highlighting MedPlus' long-term growth potential driven by its store expansion strategy.

items.title: NHPC among 5 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of July 21, five stocks from the NSE F&O segment witnessed a notable surge in futures open interest, with a total increase of over 7% compared with the previous session, based on data from StockEdge.com. A sharp rise in open interest indicates growth in active, unexpired futures contracts, reflecting increased participation and fresh position build-up.

items.title: Profit up 35%, shares down 15%: What went wrong at Bandhan Bank?
items.description: Bandhan Bank shares hit the 15% lower circuit despite a 35% jump in Q1 profit, as investors focused on the lender's sharp cut to its FY27 RoA guidance. Brokerages remained divided, with concerns over margin pressure and funding costs overshadowing stronger earnings and improved asset quality.

items.title: BlueStone Jewellery shares soar 29% in 2 days after stellar Q1 show. Should you buy, sell or hold the stock?
items.description: BlueStone Jewellery shares have surged nearly 29% in two sessions after the company swung to profit in Q1 FY27 and delivered strong revenue and EBITDA growth. While Systematix reiterated its Buy rating with a target price of Rs 832, investors are assessing whether the rally has more room to run.

items.title: Triveni Engineering shares adjust 38.5% as stock turns ex-demerger. What lies ahead for 95,000 shareholders
items.description: Triveni Engineering shares appeared to fall sharply after trading ex-demerger, but the decline reflected a technical price adjustment following the separation of its power transmission business rather than selling pressure.

items.title: SBI Funds shares fall 3%, but brokerages scream 'Buy' with target price up to Rs 750
items.description: SBI Funds Management shares fell after their market debut, but brokerages remain bullish, with Emkay and Equirus citing strong fundamentals, SBI's distribution strength and long-term growth prospects while assigning target prices of up to Rs 750.

items.title: Vedanta Oil & Gas shares fall over 3% after firm discloses two legal matters involving ONGC, GoI
items.description: Vedanta Oil & Gas share slipped on Wednesday after the company disclosed two legal matters involving the Directorate General of Hydrocarbons and ONGC. While DGH has sought about $35 million plus interest over OALP blocks, ONGC is pursuing enforcement of a $37 million arbitral award before the Delhi High Court.

items.title: Q1 Results today: Eternal, Nestle, IndusInd Bank among 63 companies announcing June earnings. What to expect?
items.description: A packed earnings day awaits Dalal Street, with Eternal, Nestlé India, IndusInd Bank and over 250 companies set to report June quarter results. Investors will also track BPCL, HPCL and Adani Group firms, while markets continue to react sharply to recent earnings from Bandhan Bank, TVS Motor and Bajaj Auto.

items.title: Sterlite Tech shares tumble 27% from June peak after 400% surge in 2026. Should you catch this falling knife?
items.description: Sterlite Technologies shares have seen a notable correction after a substantial rally. Analysts suggest this pause is normal within a broader bullish trend. A recent large order from a US hyperscaler bolsters fundamental outlook. India's data center industry expansion fuels demand for optical fiber infrastructure. Investors are weighing profit booking against potential future gains.

items.title: Cube Highways Trust InvIT subscription opens today. Here are key details for investors
items.description: Cube Highways Trust InvIT opens its Rs 5,000-crore public issue today at a price band of Rs 151–152 per unit. The infrastructure trust offers investors exposure to a diversified portfolio of operational highway assets.

items.title: Bandhan Bank shares crash 15% after Q1 results; lender cuts RoA guidance. Should you buy, sell or hold?
items.description: Bandhan Bank shares fell sharply on Wednesday after the lender cut its RoA guidance, overshadowing a 35% year-on-year rise in Q1FY27 net profit. Motilal Oswal downgraded the stock to 'Neutral', citing pressure on margins and earnings. The brokerage also lowered its FY27 and FY28 earnings estimates despite lower provisioning supporting quarterly profit.

items.title: Vedanta shares drop 26% in two months, erase all post-demerger gains. Time to buy or better to avoid?
items.description: Vedanta shares have fallen over twenty-six percent in two months.  This decline erased all gains made after the recent corporate demerger.  Analysts are still advising caution for potential investors in Vedanta.  The company's financial risk profile has improved due to strong performance.  Investors await Hindustan Zinc's earnings for further market direction.

items.title: Bajaj Auto shares rise over 2% after Q1. Should you buy, sell or hold the stock?
items.description: Bajaj Auto shares rose 2.5% after the company reported a 46% year-on-year jump in Q1FY27 net profit to Rs 3,226 crore, while revenue surged 65% to Rs 21,689 crore. Following the strong performance, Motilal Oswal upgraded the stock to 'Buy' from 'Neutral', raising its target price to Rs 12,096, implying a potential 16% upside.

items.title: Why is market falling today? 7 factors behind Sensex's 700-point fall, Rs 4 lakh crore wealth wipeout
items.description: Indian stock markets experienced a decline on Wednesday as tensions in the Middle East escalated. Crude oil prices surged above $92 a barrel, impacting investor sentiment negatively. Broader markets also slipped, with small and midcap indices showing losses. Several major banking and IT stocks contributed to the Sensex's drop. Despite these challenges, some auto and consumer stocks traded higher, bucking the trend.

items.title: Nifty in trouble but Adani Enterprises, 9 other stocks rally up to 43% in 2026
items.description: With the Iran war weighing on sentiment and the Nifty down 7.5% in 2026, these stocks have bucked the broader market trend, delivering positive returns despite heightened volatility and uncertainty. Here are top 10 Nifty gainers of 2026.

items.title: 14 midcap stocks plunge up to 50% in 6 months. Here's where FIIs and MFs stand
items.description: IRCTC stock has slipped 19% in the last six months, falling to Rs 500 from Rs 614. In the June 2026 quarter, FIIs held a 3.91% stake, while MFs owned 3.41%.

items.title: Explained: What Donald Trump's up to 200% pharma tariffs mean for Indian investors
items.description: Donald Trump's announcement of tariffs of up to 200% on pharmaceutical imports triggered a selloff in Indian pharma stocks. However, analysts believe the long-term impact could be limited, citing India's manufacturing cost advantage, US-based production facilities of several drugmakers and uncertainty over how and when the tariffs will be implemented.

items.title: Vikas Khemani’s Carnelian Asset Management receives SEBI approval for mutual fund business
items.description: Carnelian Asset Management & Advisors, founded by market veteran Vikas Khemani, received SEBI approval to launch its mutual fund business. The move will allow the firm to offer active and passive investment products across equity, debt and hybrid categories, expanding its presence beyond PMS, AIFs and offshore strategies.

items.title: HFCL's X-factor is defence & aerospace? Deven Choksey sees another 66% upside potential, here's why
items.description: HFCL shares have surged over 250% in six months, but Deven Choksey Research believes the rally is far from over. The brokerage initiated coverage with a Buy rating and a target price of Rs 362, citing defence, aerospace and AI-driven optical connectivity as the company's next major growth engines.

items.title: Canara Robeco Asset Management shares rally 13% after Q1FY27 profit jumps 24% YoY
items.description: Canara Robeco Asset Management shares jumped after the company reported a strong Q1FY27, driven by robust revenue growth, improved profitability, and steady expansion in assets under management (AUM). Revenue from operations rose 20% YoY to ₹116.2 crore, boosting investor confidence and driving the stock higher.

items.title: Cube Highways Trust InvIT raises Rs 1,687 crore from Premji Invest, other anchor investors ahead of its IPO
items.description: Cube Highways Trust InvIT raised Rs 1,687.5 crore from anchor investors ahead of its Rs 5,000-crore public issue opening on July 22. Backed by marquee institutional investors, the issue is a 100% offer for sale and provides exposure to a diversified portfolio of operational road infrastructure assets across India.

items.title: Anant Raj demerger: Data centre arm to spin out as separate listed company, what lies ahead for 4 lakh shareholders
items.description: Anant Raj will demerge its data centre and cloud businesses into a separately listed entity, Ashok Cloud, enabling shareholders to directly participate in the digital infrastructure business. Eligible shareholders will receive two Ashok Cloud shares for every Anant Raj share held, subject to regulatory approvals and the record date announcement.

items.title: How MTech alumnus’ gift turned into Rs 112 crore IPO jackpot for IIT Madras
items.description: A share gift from Indo-MIM founder and IIT Madras alumnus Krishna Chivukula is set to generate a Rs 112 crore windfall for the institute through the company's IPO. IIT Madras will sell half its gifted stake via the OFS while retaining the remaining shares, preserving upside after the listing.

items.title: Will Blinkit growth sustain amid competition? 5 things to know from Eternal's shareholder letter
items.description: Eternal's Q1 shareholder letter highlights Blinkit's rapid expansion, improving profitability and rising capital investments, while food delivery remains the group's profit engine. Management also addressed mounting quick commerce competition, outlined Blinkit's return framework and detailed continued investments in AI, Bistro and other emerging businesses despite widening losses in newer ventures.

items.title: FIIs are leaving Adani Enterprises. Here’s who is buying
items.description: Foreign investors are reducing their exposure to Adani Enterprises. FPIs held just 8.8% in Gautam Adani’s flagship company at the end of the June quarter—the lowest since 2009, according to Prime Infobase. Meanwhile, domestic institutions have overtaken foreign investors for the first time in years. Then who is buying the stocks? Watch the video to know more

items.title: 14 midcap stocks plunge up to 50% in 6 months. Here's where FIIs and MFs stand
items.description: Over the past six months, Nifty50 has declined around 4%, while the Nifty Midcap 150 index gained nearly 10%. At first glance, midcaps appear to have delivered a strong performance. However, a closer look reveals a different picture.Several midcap stocks have witnessed sharp corrections despite the index gains. We highlight 14 such stocks that have fallen 15-50% over the past six months. These stocks continue to trade 25-55% below their 52-week highs, raising the question: Are they overlooked opportunities or value traps? We also examine how major investors, foreign institutional investors (FIIs) and mutual funds (MFs), positioned themselves in these stocks during the June 2026 quarter. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Bharat Coking Coal shares crash 8% after Coal India arm posts Rs 68 crore Q1 net loss
items.description: Bharat Coking Coal shares plunged over 8% on Wednesday. The company reported a net loss of Rs 68 crore for the April-June quarter. Revenue from operations rose 4% year-on-year to Rs 3,587 crore. Total expenses increased 5% while EBITDA dropped significantly. Production and offtake output missed targets, impacting profitability.

items.title: Domestic formulations, chronic therapies to drive Pharma Q1; US generics remain drag
items.description: The healthcare sector anticipates strong growth in domestic formulations and emerging markets. Companies with less US generics dependence will likely see broad-based growth. Specialty products and biosimilars are expected to be key growth drivers. Hospitals are projected to continue outperforming with capacity additions and improving occupancy. Margins may contract due to higher costs and new facility ramp-up expenses.
